name: Soybeans; dry processing; region 3, at farm
description: This unit process represents the production of soybeans in Region 3 in the US.  The energy inputs, material inputs, air emissions, water inputs, and water effluents are  directly used from data collected and aggregated by the National Oilseed Processors Association (NOPA) (http://www.nescaum.org/documents/stakeholder-comments-on-the-low-carbon-fuels-standard/comments-from-national-biodiesel-board/soybean-processing-documentation1-26-09-nopa-board-revision-030409.pdf/).
category: 11: Agriculture, Forestry, Fishing and Hunting/1111: Oilseed and Grain Farming

processDocumentation.timeDescription: Producer survey and literature data (NASS, Budgets, USLCI, EPA) covering years 2005-2009
processDocumentation.geographyDescription: The unit process is assumed to represent regional production in Region 3.  US Region 3 including Minnesota, Wisconsin, Michigan, Ohio, Indiana, Illinois, Missouri, and Iowa.
processDocumentation.technologyDescription: Cradle-to-processing plant gate system boundary. The allocation of material and energy inputs of soybeans is based on NOPA Soybean Crushing and Extraction Process soybean oil/soybean meal 80:20.  For more information on this process, see NOPA (2016). Unit process includes flows from EarthShift DataSmart LCI database.
processDocumentation.inventoryMethodDescription: Life cycle inventory was originally assembled using the SimaPro software platform (Version 8.0.4.26) and was modified for submission using the OpenLCA platform (Version 1.3.0).
processDocumentation.completenessDescription: This model includes main resource use and environmnetal impact drivers. It excludes soybean hulls. Regional soybean production including Soybeans, region 2, at farm/US U, Soybeans, region 3, at farm/US U, Soybeans, region 4, at farm/US U were modeled by University of Arkansas.
processDocumentation.dataSelectionDescription: Data collected from literature. The data that NOPA received were provided as full-facility inputs and outputs on a per-soybean input basis, and cover soybean processing via solvent extraction through crude oil degumming
processDocumentation.dataTreatmentDescription: NOPA’s data, which it obtained by surveying its 15 member companies in mid-December 2008 for data reflective of each company’s most recent fiscal year, do not reflect the performance of any single soybean processing plant. Rather, the data reflect company-applied data that NOPA received on 50 of the 60 soybean processing plants that it represents, and are broadly reflective of energy and material inputs and outputs for soybean processing plants similar in general design and processes to the plant that was evaluated in the 1998 Report.
processDocumentation.dataCollectionDescription: Data was collected during an ongoing project in 2010

reviews.details: University of Arkansas swine dataset mapped to USLCI technosphere flows and FEDEFL elementary flows for publication on the Federal LCA Commons. Review covers mapping crosswalks, cutoff flows, and export structure.

processDocumentation.intendedApplication: These data may be used in Situation C2, “Accounting without interactions.”  This is applicable to accounting studies that according to their goal definition do not include any interaction with other systems.
